remove.title: Delete {name}?
remove.hint: The Skill's directory will be deleted. This can't be undone.

enabled.help: When disabled, it doesn't appear in the system prompt and can't be read. Save after changing.
enabled.label: Enable this Skill

install.hint: Supports .skill / .zip packages or a single SKILL.md (max 10 MiB). You can also send a Skill file to the assistant on QQ and ask it to install it. Scripts that come with a Skill are external code, so only install Skills you trust.
install.title: Install a Skill
install.replace: Replace a Skill with the same name

list.help: List the names and descriptions of enabled Skills so the assistant reads the right one when it fits.
list.label: List Skills in the system prompt

enabled.help: When on, Agent mode offers tools such as skill_list, skill_read, and skill_write.
enabled.label: Enable Skills
